notes: Every portal gets every rune, for now. The Content Designer offers all fifteen runes on every card shape of every portal — Mirage, Charm and Omen — each with a live preview, and every one starts with something on the canvas.

The layout maker lets you put any rune on any Mirage card. A rune whose built-in look doesn't fit the card is marked 'designs only': it draws from a design made for that card's shape, and until you make one the card shows its placeholder.
